Thanks for taking the time this morning, Kate  good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call: 

Key notes from discovery:
- Acme is evaluating private deployment options for inference (VPC peering and on-prem options).
- Primary security concerns: SOC 2 status and timeline, GDPR data residency & processing, and whether HIPAA controls are required for any PII/PHI (you indicated likely not).
- Acme would like clarity on network isolation, support for air-gapped/on-prem installs, and options for HSM/KMS integration.
- You requested a vendor security questionnaire (we can start with your SQ template) and a high-level deployment diagram showing VPC peering/private control plane options.

Proposed next steps: 
1) I can share our standard vendor SQ template and a Redwood deployment diagram tailored to Acme. If you can share your SQ, we can fill and return by end of week.
2) Loop in Redwood security and CS to review any compliance gaps  copying Laura.
3) Schedule a short technical follow-up to walk through the deployment diagram and network options (30 min).

Would you prefer us to: (A) complete your SQ and return, or (B) take our SQ to speed the review? Also, please confirm whether HIPAA is in scope and who the primary security contact at Acme should be (email for vendor SQ).

Attachments: I will attach a generic vendor SQ and a sample deployment diagram in the follow-up.

Thanks  talk soon.



Thanks Marcus  good summary. A few quick answers: 
- We prefer you complete our vendor SQ; attaching the template. Please return the filled copy.
- SOC 2: Acme is SOC 2 Type II certified for our core platform; however, we need vendor evidence for subservice organizations. We expect SOC 2 evidence for vendors by Q1 2027.
- GDPR: applicable; processing will be within US and EU regions depending on dataset.
- HIPAA: not in scope for this project.
- HSM/KMS: we require KMS integration and support for customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) for production.

Also attaching our vendor SQ (Acme_Vendor_SQ_filled.xlsx) which has a few preliminary fields filled by our security team.

Regarding deployment: we are open to VPC peering or a dedicated private deployment (on-prem is a fallback but would need a separate engagement). Can you share the deployment diagram showing the private control plane option and network flow? Also note any requirements for our infra team around firewall rules and peering CIDR ranges.

Thanks  Kate
Kate Turner
Head of IT Security, Acme Corp
